name: Good morning
summary: Hands behind the head, hinge at the hips with a flat back until the trunk is near level, then stand.
setup: Stand side-on to the phone, hands behind the head, knees soft. Push the hips back and bow forward with a flat back until the trunk is near level, then squeeze the glutes to stand.
brief: Stand with the hands behind the head, knees soft. Push the hips back and bow forward with a flat back until the trunk is near level, then squeeze the glutes to stand.
why: From the side the trunk angle gives the hinge, and the knees bending to cheat is caught by the knee angle.
progression: Band around the neck and under the feet; light bar.

faults.label: Not reaching the target
faults.tip: Take each rep through the full range you set — half reps count as partials.

faults.label: Too fast
faults.tip: Control both directions; momentum takes the work away from the muscle.

faults.label: Back rounding
faults.tip: Stop before the back rounds; the range grows as the hamstrings loosen.

faults.label: Going too low
faults.tip: Your depth ends where the back would round, usually well above horizontal.

faults.label: Looking up
faults.tip: Craning to look forward as you fold hyperextends the neck.
